@@ -1,5 +1,25 @@
+# Copy to .env.local for local development overrides.
+# Keep real secrets out of git.
+
 # App
-NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
+APP_URL=
+NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=
+APP_PORT=
+
+# Database
+DATABASE_URL=
+POSTGRES_DB=
+POSTGRES_USER=
+POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
+POSTGRES_PORT=
+
+# Redis
+REDIS_URL=
+REDIS_PORT=
+
+# Auth and providers
+AUTH_SECRET=
+ZAI_API_KEY=
 
-# Server-only secrets/configuration will be introduced in later milestones.
-# Do not commit real secrets. Keep local values in .env.local.
+# Storage
+STORAGE_ROOT=

@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+services:
+  app:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      target: dev
+    command: npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0
+    ports:
+      - "${APP_PORT:-3000}:3000"
+    environment:
+      APP_URL: ${APP_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
+      NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
+      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://dnd:dnd@postgres:5432/dnd_firegory}
+      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379}
+      AUTH_SECRET: ${AUTH_SECRET:-dev-only-change-me}
+      ZAI_API_KEY: ${ZAI_API_KEY:-}
+      STORAGE_ROOT: ${STORAGE_ROOT:-/app/storage}
+    volumes:
+      - .:/app
+      - node_modules:/app/node_modules
+      - app_storage:/app/storage
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      redis:
+        condition: service_healthy
+
+  worker:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      target: dev
+    command:
+      - node
+      - -e
+      - |
+        console.log('Worker placeholder started. Ingestion/RAG worker will be implemented in a later issue.');
+        setInterval(() => {}, 60_000);
+    environment:
+      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://dnd:dnd@postgres:5432/dnd_firegory}
+      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL:-redis://redis:6379}
+      ZAI_API_KEY: ${ZAI_API_KEY:-}
+      STORAGE_ROOT: ${STORAGE_ROOT:-/app/storage}
+    volumes:
+      - .:/app
+      - node_modules:/app/node_modules
+      - app_storage:/app/storage
+    depends_on:
+      postgres:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      redis:
+        condition: service_healthy
+
+  postgres:
+    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
+    environment:
+      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-dnd_firegory}
+      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-dnd}
+      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-dnd}
+    ports:
+      - "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432"
+    volumes:
+      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
+      - ./docker/postgres/init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
+      interval: 5s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 10
+
+  redis:
+    image: redis:7-alpine
+    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
+    ports:
+      - "${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379"
+    volumes:
+      - redis_data:/data
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
+      interval: 5s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 10
+
+volumes:
+  app_storage:
+  node_modules:
+  postgres_data:
+  redis_data:
